Title: Confessions of a Type A Girl: When Your Plan Only Works on a Perfect Day
Description: Marathons, 5 a.m. alarms and a list for everything. What happened when my hour-by-hour winter arc schedule met real life, and the two changes that made it realistic.

Title: A Realistic Winter Arc Schedule: My Original Plan vs. the Revised One
Description: My hour-by-hour winter arc schedule next to the revised version: a wake-up range, one flex block each evening and weekly goals instead of daily ones. A realistic daily routine for a 9-to-5.

Title: For the Type A Girl: Your Plan Shouldn’t Need a Perfect Day
Description: If your schedule only works when nothing goes wrong, it’s the schedule, not you. How I gave my Type A plans some breathing room.

Title: How to Build a Schedule With Breathing Room (for Type A People)
Description: Four ways to make an ambitious schedule realistic: give each day a range, count two of four priorities as a good day, set weekly goals and let sleep win after a late night.

Title: Type A Personality Traits: 5 Signs You’re Type A
Description: The five Type A personality traits: driven and ambitious, time urgent, competitive, high control and multitasking, and a higher stress risk. Plus what being Type A looks like in real life.

Title: Productivity Tip for Overachievers: Two Out of Four Is a Good Day
Pinterest board: Career Tips for Your First Job
Description: Working a 9-to-5 and juggling workouts, a side project and classes? Stop expecting every priority every day. Two out of four is a good day, and all four is a bonus.

Title: Set Weekly Goals, Not Daily Ones: A Realistic Winter Arc
Description: Daily goals turn one missed day into a pile-up. Weekly goals like five workouts or five hours of coursework fit around travel, meetings and late nights.
